mapping.summary: Manages bank guarantees and letters of credit with limits, approvals and expiry alerts.
claims: Handles bank guarantees and letters of credit for both sales and purchases
Lifecycle statuses Open, Pending for Approval, Released and Closed with record locking
Links instruments to purchase orders, sales orders and projects
Shows utilised, available and remaining limits as transactions post
Multi-level approvals for issuance and closure
Keeps amendment history with version tracking
Links instruments to customers and vendors
Aligns instrument data with ledger entries
Daily expiry email alerts via job queue with configurable notice period
Credit Manager role center with cues by status
Printable RDLC reports for guarantees and letters of credit
